name: Alexios
bio: Archetype: Assassination, Ult DPT. ⌽ Instead of using Moxie, gains [Adrenaline] at the start of every round. If sufficient, [Adrenaline] stacks are consumed to generate an Ultimate. ⌽ Normal skills deal damage and generate [Adrenaline]. ⌽ Ultimate deals AoE damage, is considered an [Assassination], and grants [Blood of Isu], further increasing Ultimate damage on future casts. ⌽ Gains [Adrenaline] whenever an ally triggers [Assassination]. Additionally, if said ally has the [Assassination] role, has a chance to cast his Ultimate.
